display.title: A Healthy Soul in a Healthy Body: Giving Tzedakah on Shabbos
display.summary_short: The soul needs daily Torah and three 'meals' of davening, and Uncle Yossi explains how to give tzedakah for Shabbos even though money may not be touched.
display.summary_long: A summer talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi wishes children a joyful summer for body and soul. The neshamah also needs exercise and food: daily Torah study strengthens it against the yetzer hara, and just as the body has breakfast, lunch and supper, the soul has Shacharis, Mincha and Maariv. As the Alter Rebbe said, a healthy soul brings a healthy body. Tzedakah should be given every day; since money is muktzah on Shabbos, we add Shabbos tzedakah before lighting the candles on Friday. The Rebbe taught that we can also give tzedakah on Shabbos itself, by inviting guests who have nowhere to eat and by teaching someone Torah, the greatest treasure we can share. Children going to a bungalow or camp should take a pushka along.
display.lesson: Feed your soul every day with Torah, davening and tzedakah, even on Shabbos and on vacation.

sources_cited.note: Torah, the greatest fortune we can share.
